name: wCookie
author: Joomla Service Provider

sections.description:
wCookie allows you to display a cookie or legal notice on your WordPress website to inform visitors about cookie usage and compliance requirements.

You can customize the notice content using HTML, add links to policy pages, and control the appearance with styling options.

The plugin provides multiple display positions including top, bottom, bottom left, bottom right, and floating layouts. It is fully responsive and works across all devices.

Features

  • Customizable cookie notice text with HTML support
  • Multiple display positions (Top, Bottom, Bottom Left, Bottom Right, Floating)
  • Custom styling options for colors and layout
  • Fully mobile responsive design
  • Easy setup and configuration
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/wcookie directory, or install via the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure the plugin settings as needed.
sections.faq:
Can I customize the notice text?

Yes, you can use HTML to customize the message and add links.

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes, the plugin is fully responsive and works on all screen sizes.
